description: This file defines the Percentage class, which extends NumberBase and implements Wizard, providing methods to format percentages with locale and decimal precision settings within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Percentage
classes.description: A class for creating locale-aware percentage number formats with customizable decimal places in PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Percentage formatter with optional decimals and locale settings.

methods.name: getLocaleFormat
methods.description: Constructs a locale-specific percentage format string based on the current locale and decimal settings.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the formatted percentage string based on locale and decimal settings.

calls: Locale (assumed to be a class used within getLocaleFormat)
